To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the two poplar clones showed different sensitivity to ozone.

1) the photosynthetic activity in leaves of poplar clone I-214 exposed to ozone was strongly reduced by stomatal closure and by a limitation of the dark reaction of photosynthesis; 2) in poplar clone Eridano the photosynthetic capacity was decreased due to the exposure, but the stomatal conductance remained unchanged; 3) in Eridano the reduction in the CO2 assimilating capacity was related to an inhibition of photosynthetic electron transfer,
the photosynthetic apparatus of poplar clones I-214 and Eridano is differentially affected by long-term exposure to ozone, and this differential effect is due to different mechanisms.
